args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and your contact email is easy to find. To improve it, you could add more about yourself, such as your projects, interests or background, and some visuals to make it more engaging. Nice work!

Hi Eve, I enjoyed visiting your blog. It has a friendly, personal tone, and I like that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby. You could add some posts about your hikes, with photos, trail tips and favorite routes, to give readers more to explore. Great start!

final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback by direct message.

- **Dora:** I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@gmail.com), then messaged her. I said her site is clean, simple and easy to contact. I suggested adding more about her projects, interests and background, plus some visuals.
- **Eve:** I messaged her that her blog has a friendly, personal tone. I suggested posts about her hikes, with photos, trail tips and favorite routes.
